newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech bank CZK 857 mln 96 net profit - IAS.
newsitem.headline: Czech bank CZK 857 mln 96 net profit - IAS.

text.p: IPB a.s., the Czech Republic's third largest bank, said on Friday that according to an audited preliminary report, its 1996 net profit was 857 million crowns, calculated according to international accounting standards (IAS).
IPB, which posted a 1.01 billion crown net profit in 1995, said the results, which were based on a finalised audit, should be confirmed this month "without qualification".
The statement gave no further details of the bank's 1996 results.
In early March, IPB reported a preliminary 1996 net profit of 1.51 billion crowns.
IPB said the audited figures were provided by the Ernst and Young accounting firm.
The Czech bond and share markets have been rife with rumours that IPB would report massive losses on its 1996 results.
In early March, IPB announced it was changing its auditor from Coopers & Lybrand to Ernst and Young for an unspecified reason.
